content.short: Whal3s is a developer platform to easily create, deliver and manage token utilities.
content.description: Demand for token utility remains strong, yet Web3 deployment tools are still archaic, offering only APIs. The Whal3s Framework lets Web2 developers and agencies ship utilities in minutes by providing a complete stack. Use the Whal3s App to set up the utility, integrate it with your existing app or website via the SDK, and enhance the user experience with the API. It can store usage data, removing the need to operate your own server.
